title: Inference for Interpretable Text-Diffusion Models
summary: We present the Causal Diffusion Engine (CDE), a serving engine for interpretable diffusion language models.
body_markdown: We present the[Causal Diffusion Engine (CDE)](https://github.com/guidelabs/gl_cde) , a serving engine for interpretable diffusion language models. CDE powers[Clarity](https://www.guidelabs.ai/post/meet-clarity/) , our platform for serving[Steerling](https://github.com/guidelabs/steerling) , our 8B-parameter block-causal diffusion LLM that traces any group of generated tokens back to human-understandable concepts, and lets users steer generation through those concepts. Existing production serving engines such as vLLM and SGLang do not treat interpretability as a first-class citizen. CDE delivers low-latency diffusion language model serving while enabling interpretability primitives like concept attributions and steering alongside every generated token. We describe the design decisions that make this possible, including block-causal paged attention with a KV cache, specialized` torch.compile` graphs, memory-efficient concept heads, and request-time concept steering without recompilation.
